source_text: Interim per dies plurimos effusione sanguinis transmittebatur ad dominum numerosa fraternitas, nec peruenire ad Mariani et Iacobi clericorumque uictimam rabies insanientis praesidis poterat, laicorum tam multis occupata uulneribus. Nam ita inter se nostrae religionis gradus artifex saeuitia diuiserat, ut laicos a clericis separatos temptationibus saeculi et terroribus suis putaret esse cessuros. Ergo carissimi nostri et fidelissimi milites Christi ceterique de clero contristari aliquantulum coeperant, quod, laicis certaminis sui laude perfunctis, seruaretur sibi tam lenta et tam sera uictoria.
pass_a_gloss: Meanwhile, over very many days, by pouring-out of blood, a numerous brotherhood was being forwarded to the Lord, and the frenzy of the raging governor was not able to arrive at the slaughter-offering of Marian and James and of the clergy, busy as it was with so many wounds of laymen. For designing cruelty had divided the ranks of our religion apart from each other in this way, so that it supposed laymen, cut off from clerics, would give way to worldly enticements and to its own terrors. So our dearest and most loyal soldiers of Christ and the rest from the clergy had begun to grow rather downcast, because, with laymen having discharged the praise of their own contest, so sluggish and so late a victory was being kept back for themselves.
pass_b_english: Meanwhile, through many days, a great company of the brethren was passing to the Lord by the shedding of blood, and the rage of the frenzied governor could not reach the sacrifice of Marianus and James and the clergy, since it was still occupied with the many wounds of the laity. For ingenious cruelty had set the orders of our faith against one another in this way, supposing that the laity, once parted from the clergy, would surrender to the allurements of the world and to its terrors. Our dearest therefore and most faithful soldiers of Christ, and the others of the clergy, had begun to grieve a little, because, while the laity had fulfilled the honor of their struggle, a victory so slow and so late was still being held in reserve for them.
